gaps.finding: Requested agent IDs do not exist in either legacy agent_name enum. Verification is not a proven alias of exception_incident_agent.
gaps.resolution: Preserve legacy history; use a reviewed dedicated assessment schema or explicitly approved migration.

gaps.finding: agent_execution and agent_decision lack explicit tenant/actor/resource-version fields.
gaps.resolution: Require typed tenant, actor, request, resource and snapshot references in new assessment records; scope every read and write server-side.

gaps.finding: approval_request.request_type has no generic assessment review or organization onboarding value.
gaps.resolution: Design separate recommendation review and onboarding approval contracts; do not overload refund or dispatch approval.

gaps.finding: Most agent input tables have no expected-version field.
gaps.resolution: Approve transactionally consistent snapshot and stale-result detection before runtime integration.

gaps.finding: Polymorphic compliance owner and customer/vendor joins need application authorization beyond table references.
gaps.resolution: Test every owner type, mismatched join and tenant boundary.

constraints: organization and actor references verified server-side
organization must equal parent assessment organization
evidence refs must belong to immutable assessment snapshot
review is not approval to execute operations

migrationGate: Native types, physical constraints, retention, reviewer grants, transactional persistence and rollback must be reviewed and tested in the independently isolated target. No live migration is authorized.
